summary: NextEra Energy Capital Holdings Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to register the issuance of three series of junior subordinated debentures due 2056-2066, guaranteed by NextEra Energy Inc. The terms (interest rates, reset spreads) are left blank as preliminary. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine debt offering to raise capital for general corporate purposes.
